India Warns Citizens Against Job Seeking on Malaysia's Visa-Free Entry

The Indian government has issued an advisory warning its nationals against misusing Malaysia's 30-day visa-free entry scheme to seek employment. Officials stated that using the visa-free provision for job hunting constitutes a clear violation of immigration rules. The advisory specifically targets individuals seeking jobs in Malaysia.
